title: Fox motif
subtitle: A flat applique fox face with pointed ears and white muzzle, 9 cm
excerpt: The fox motif builds a round orange dc head with two sharply pointed ear triangles worked from the top edge, a white oval muzzle sewn in place, and a black nose. The angular ear construction and the muzzle overlay together identify the piece as a fox rather than the rounder cat or rabbit. At 9 cm in DK cotton it is a strong applique centrepiece for cushions, book bags, and autumn-theme blankets.
sourceNotes: Synthesised from flat applique animal face construction. Weldon's Practical Crochet, Volume 9 (1894), animal applique chapter (Internet Archive).
heroPrompt: A crochet fox face applique in burnt orange DK cotton with white muzzle, pointed ears, and a black nose, 9 cm across, photographed flat on natural linen in soft daylight.

chartDefinition.title: Fox motif
chartDefinition.caption: Round orange head from magic ring. Two sharply-pointed ear triangles from the head top border. White oval muzzle worked separately and sewn on.

glossaryTerms.definition: An adjustable starting loop that pulls closed to leave no visible centre hole. The fox head starts here.

content.text: The fox face shares the same round head construction as the cat and rabbit, from a

outward to 24 dc. The ears are sharper triangles than the cat (they reach full treble height in a single stitch rather than rounding over) and are worked directly from the border. The muzzle is a small white oval chain-worked in the round and sewn over the lower centre of the face. A black French knot sits at the top of the muzzle for the nose.

attrs.title: Materials for one motif
attrs.body: About 10 g of orange DK cotton, 4 g of white for the muzzle. A 4 mm hook. Tapestry needle. Black embroidery thread for nose and eyes. Scissors.

content.text: Each finished fox motif measures 9 cm wide and 10 cm tall including ears in DK-weight cotton with a 4 mm hook.
chain (ch), slip stitch (sl st), magic ring (MR) — UK and US shared.
half treble (htr) — UK; US "half double crochet".
Form a magic ring. Ch 1. Rnd 1: 6dc. Sl st. (6 dc.) Rnd 2: 2dc in each. Sl st. (12 dc.) Rnd 3: *Dc. 2dc.* Repeat 6 times. Sl st. (18 dc.) Rnd 4: *Dc. Dc. 2dc.* Repeat 6 times. Sl st. (24 dc.)

Count 3 dc to the left of top centre. Sl st into that dc. Ch 1. Dc. Htr. Tr (ear tip — taller than cat, giving the sharp fox point). Htr. Dc. Sl st to close. Fasten off. Rejoin at 3 dc to the right of centre; repeat for right ear.
In white, ch 6. Dc in 2nd ch from hook and across. (4 dc.) Turn. Row 2: Ch 1. 2dc. Dc. Dc. 2dc. (6 dc.) Turn. Row 3: Ch 1. Dc across. (6 dc.) Fasten off with 20 cm tail.
Sew the white muzzle panel over the lower centre of the face with a tapestry needle. Embroider two small eyes near the top of the face and a black French knot nose at the top of the muzzle.

definition.title: Fox motif
definition.caption: 4-round magic ring head to 24dc. Sharp ear triangles: dc/htr/tr/htr/dc from head border. White muzzle panel sewn over lower face.

content.text: Weave in all ends. Sew the finished fox onto the base fabric through the head perimeter.
Handwash in cool water. Lay flat to dry.

The cat (crochet-animal-cat) and rabbit (crochet-animal-rabbit) use the same head disc. The autumn leaf motifs (crochet-leaf-oak, crochet-leaf-maple) pair naturally with the fox for a woodland-scene blanket.
